title: Ho Chi Minh City walk
summary: District 1 from the cathedral square to Ben Thanh, with the palace if the heat allows.

stops.name: Notre-Dame square and the Post Office
stops.note: The cathedral may be closed for works. The post office interior is the sure stop.

stops.name: Dong Khoi
stops.note: Walk toward the river, then turn inland.

stops.name: Ben Thanh Market
stops.note: Look, then eat lunch nearby rather than in the tourist stalls.

seoTitle: Ho Chi Minh City walking itinerary
seoDescription: A half-day walk through District 1 in Ho Chi Minh City.
